standard_prompt: SIMPLE GEOMETRIC FLAT-VECTOR puppet character for 2D cut-out animation (same style as our approved Shiva): capsule/tapered arms and legs with visible round darker joint discs at shoulders, elbows, hips and knees, flat solid colours with ONE darker shade tone, thin warm cream outline, minimal detail, NO painterly texture. HEROIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: about 7 heads tall, smaller head, broad shoulders, long torso, long legs (NOT chibi, NOT a bobble-head, NOT a child unless stated). STRAIGHT FRONT VIEW, FULL BODY, feet visible, arms held slightly away from the body with relaxed OPEN EMPTY hands (no held objects, no weapons, no props in the hands), legs slightly apart, so every limb is clearly separate. ONE solid flat pure green (#00FF00) background with a margin, no shadow, no border, no text.
